bibl.title: Disease Proxies and the Diagnosis of the Late Antonine Economy.
bibl.seg: Colin P. Elliott, Disease Proxies and the Diagnosis of the Late Antonine Economy.
Koenraad Verboven (ed.), Complexity Economics. Building a New Approach to Ancient Economic History = Palgrave Studies in Ancient Economies (Cham, 2021) pp. 297-326, figg.
bibl.note: Evidence from Roman Egypt clearly shows demographic disruptions around the time of the Antonine plague. - 1. Price proxies and plague [in Roman Egypt]. - 2. Wages, the military and plague mortality. - 3. Conclusion: on proxies and quantification.
